# Relationship Atlas source and use notice

Relationship Atlas is an independent, noncommercial educational reference. It
is not affiliated with or endorsed by FetLife.

Short Kinktionary excerpts are attributed to FetLife and link to their original
pages. They are included under the [FetLife Kinktionary
License](https://fetlife.com/kinktionary/license-zcfzz). Source paragraphs are
truncated to excerpts of no more than 24 words; those truncations are the only
changes represented as source excerpts.

Partner-side mappings, pairing rules, classifications, axes, interface copy,
and workflow behavior are Relationship Atlas editorial additions. They are not
FetLife-declared reciprocal relationships.

FetLife's [Terms of
Use](https://fetlife.com/legal/terms-of-use-hwfvu) restrict automated collection
and commercial exploitation of platform data. This release uses a reviewed,
authenticated, manual capture and does not include a crawler or live platform
integration. Obtain FetLife's express written permission before commercial use
or automated collection.

Public artifacts intentionally exclude member names, linked-profile
identifiers, authentication data, sessions, and captured profile rows.
